description: This file defines the Drawing class responsible for serializing drawing images and charts into XML format within the XLSX writer component of PhpSpreadsheet. It handles writing drawings, charts, and related visual elements, including VML header/footer images, to an XML string, facilitating their inclusion in Excel files.

classes.name: Drawing
classes.description: A class responsible for exporting drawings, images, charts, and VML header/footer images into XML format for XLSX files.

methods.name: writeDrawings
methods.description: Serializes all drawings and optionally charts in a worksheet into XML at the specified location in the XLSX file.

methods.name: writeChart
methods.description: Serializes a chart object as XML, including position, size, and related graphic elements.

methods.name: writeDrawing
methods.description: Serializes a single drawing object (image) into XML, either as a two-cell anchor, one-cell anchor, or absolute position, including hyperlink and shadow effects.

methods.name: writeVMLHeaderFooterImages
methods.description: Creates XML for header/footer images in VML format for inclusion in header or footer sections.

methods.name: writeVMLHeaderFooterImage
methods.description: Serializes individual header/footer images into VML shape elements.

methods.name: allDrawings
methods.description: Returns an array of all drawings across all sheets in a spreadsheet.

methods.name: writeHyperLinkDrawing
methods.description: Writes hyperlink information for drawings if hyperlink data is present.

methods.name: stringEmu
methods.description: Helper function converting pixel measurements to EMU units used in drawing XML.
